mails.subject: Dossier de succession n° 2026-0417 : désignation de votre structure comme légataire
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Nous nous permettons de vous écrire au nom de l'Étude Verbrugge & Associés, spécialisée dans le règlement des successions internationales.

Dans le cadre du dossier référencé ci-dessus, feu M. Anders Kjeldsen, ancien utilisateur d'espaces de travail partagés à Copenhague, a désigné par testament olographe la structure « Havnehuset Cowork », que vous gérez, comme légataire d'une somme de 2 400 000 EUR, destinée au soutien des espaces communautaires indépendants.

Afin de finaliser le transfert des fonds, nous devons recueillir les éléments suivants dans un délai de dix jours ouvrés :
- une copie de la pièce d'identité du représentant légal de l'espace ;
- les coordonnées bancaires de la structure (IBAN et BIC) ;
- le règlement des frais d'enregistrement et de certification du legs, d'un montant de 1 850 EUR.

Ces frais sont exigibles avant tout déblocage, conformément à la procédure en vigueur. Vous pouvez les régler et déposer vos documents de manière sécurisée sur notre portail : https://portail.verbrugge-notaires.example/legs/2026-0417

Nous vous rappelons que ce dossier est strictement confidentiel et vous prions de ne pas en discuter avec des tiers avant la clôture de la procédure.

Dans l'attente de votre retour, nous vous prions d'agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de nos salutations distinguées.

Maître Odile Verbrugge
Étude Verbrugge & Associés, Département des successions internationales
succession@verbrugge-notaires.example
mails.justification: Unsolicited advance-fee inheritance scam: a stranger's law firm claims a legacy for the space and demands a 1,850 EUR fee and bank details, despite the formal tone and the mention of the space's name.

mails.subject: Your seat for the Flowstack launch webinar
mails.body: Hi Nordhavn Commons team, as a community space you will love Flowstack 3.0, our new invoicing assistant for small teams. Join our live launch webinar on 23 September, 11:00 CET, and see it in action. Early bird seat: 149 EUR instead of 249 EUR, register here: https://launchlane-events.example/flowstack-webinar

mails.subject: Er jeres næste kollega allerede fundet? 😊
mails.body:
Hej Lars 👋 Vi har lige nu 40+ dygtige freelancere og konsulenter klar til start i København, både udvikling, design og marketing. Svar bare på denne mail, så sender jeg tre profiler i dag 🚀 God dag til jer derude i fællesskabet! 🌟

mails.subject: Good to connect after the event
mails.body:
Hi,

It was great to connect with some of your team at the community event last month. I really enjoyed the energy of the space and the people there.

At Brightkiln we help communities and organisations like yours grow their reach and unlock new opportunities through strategic collaboration. I believe there is a lot of potential synergy between us.

I would love to explore how we could partner on joint initiatives. Do you have 20 minutes next week for a quick intro call? I can send over a short deck beforehand.

Looking forward to staying in touch,
Daniel Reyes
Partnerships, Brightkiln
mails.justification: The claim of having met at an event has no concrete detail (no event name, no person, no topic) and the proposal is a vague generic partnership pitch from a sender with no real relationship to the space.

mails.subject: Re: Votre espace de coworking et la prospection
mails.body:
> Merci de votre message, nous reviendrons vers vous.

Bonjour,

Je me permets de relancer notre échange précédent, au cas où il vous aurait échappé. Je sais que la gestion d'un espace de coworking à Copenhague demande beaucoup de temps, et je ne voudrais pas vous déranger inutilement.

Chez Prospectio, nous aidons les espaces de travail partagés à remplir leurs postes libres grâce à de la génération de leads automatisée. Notre outil identifie chaque semaine des freelances et des petites équipes qui cherchent un lieu, et leur envoie un premier message personnalisé en votre nom.

Quelques résultats sur des structures comparables :
- 35 demandes de visite qualifiées par mois en moyenne ;
- un coût par contact inférieur à 12 EUR ;
- une mise en place en moins de 48 heures, sans engagement la première année.

Nous proposons en ce moment une période pilote à 290 EUR par mois, avec un onboarding offert si vous nous répondez avant la fin du mois.

Pourriez-vous me dire quel créneau vous conviendrait pour une démonstration de 15 minutes ? Je suis disponible jeudi ou vendredi.

Je vous remercie par avance pour votre retour.

Bien cordialement,
Camille Laurent
Responsable partenariats, Prospectio
https://prospectio.example/demo
mails.justification: The 'Re:' and the quoted line fake a conversation, but the space never wrote to this sender; it is a cold lead-generation sales pitch.

mails.subject: Guest post for your community blog
mails.body:
Hello,

I hope you are well. I read your recent post about the coworking community in Copenhagen and enjoyed it, especially the part about how members support each other.

I write for RankHarbor, a content studio, and I would like to contribute a guest article to your blog. Our writers have produced pieces on remote work, productivity and small business growth, and I think your readers would find them valuable.

Here is what I can offer:
- a 1,200 word original article, written for your audience;
- full editing and images supplied by us;
- one or two contextual links back to our client sites, placed naturally in the text.

There is a small sponsorship fee of 120 EUR per placement to cover editorial costs, which many of our partner sites find reasonable. If you prefer, we can also arrange a link swap with one of our high authority domains, such as https://pressmentor.example or https://growthledger.example.

We can usually publish within a week of approval. I can send you three topic ideas tomorrow if you are interested.

Thanks for your time and have a lovely weekend.

Best regards,
Oliver Grant
Outreach Manager, RankHarbor
https://rankharbor.example
mails.justification: A generic guest-post offer that praises the blog without any real detail and sells paid backlinks to client sites, from a sender the space never contacted.

mails.subject: Your community space has been selected
mails.body:
Hello,

I am writing from Meridian Assets Group. We are running a community support programme for independent workspaces in Northern Europe, and your space has been selected to receive a grant of 18,000 EUR.

To release the grant we first need to verify your organisation. This only takes a few minutes. We ask for a refundable verification deposit of 400 EUR, paid in cryptocurrency (USDT) to the wallet shown on the application page. The deposit is returned together with the grant.

Application page: https://meridian-assets.example/grant-apply

Selected spaces must complete the verification within five days, otherwise the grant goes to the next organisation on our list.

Kind regards,
Elena Whitcombe
Grants Desk, Meridian Assets Group
mails.justification: A prize or grant scam that asks for a crypto deposit up front from an organisation the space has never dealt with, despite the polite tone and the reference to community spaces.

mails.subject: Invitation til Nordisk Erhvervsdialog 2026, Aarhus
mails.body:
Kære leder af fælles- og kontorfællesskaber,

Foreningen Nordisk Erhvervsdialog har fornøjelsen af at invitere jer til årets konference, som afholdes den 21. november 2026 i Aarhus under temaet "Fremtidens arbejdsfællesskaber".

Programmet omfatter oplæg om iværksætteri, fleksible kontorformer og regionale udviklingsmuligheder, efterfulgt af netværksmiddag.

Deltagelse koster 2.495 DKK pr. person ekskl. moms. Tilmelding sker via https://nordisk-erhvervsdialog.example/tilmelding senest den 30. oktober.

Vi håber at kunne byde jer velkommen.

Med venlig hilsen
Sekretariatet, Foreningen Nordisk Erhvervsdialog
mails.justification: Mass marketing for a paid conference sent to a generic addressee (a manager of shared offices) who never subscribed or registered, in an institutional tone that mimics a professional association.

mails.subject: Staffing support for your members' companies
mails.body:
Dear community manager,

We work with startups and small companies in Greater Copenhagen that need qualified people quickly. Many of them are based in coworking spaces like yours.

Staffwell Nordic currently has candidates available in sales, customer support and bookkeeping, with start dates within two weeks. Our fee is 8,500 DKK per placement, with no charge if the candidate leaves within 90 days.

We would be glad if you could share our offer with your members or add our link to your community board: https://staffwell-nordic.example/members

Please feel free to forward this email to anyone who might be hiring.

Best regards,
Katrine Moll
Business Development, Staffwell Nordic
mails.justification: A recruitment blast sent to the space as a distribution channel for its members, with no prior relationship and no question or request that needs a reply from the space.
